pr_title: Added New Test Case for Pod Deletion
pr_body:
Solves #126436

Description: This pull request adds a test case specifically for Pod deletion in Kubernetes. The goal is to ensure that Pods are deleted properly across different scenarios, including edge cases. I've included thorough documentation to explain how the test works and why it’s important, along with links to the relevant code files. This addition is a key step in enhancing the robustness of our Pod lifecycle testing and documentation.

issue_context.title: Create New Test Cases for Pod Lifecycle Events
issue_context.body:
**What should be added?**
This issue focuses on writing new test cases that cover Pod lifecycle events in Kubernetes. The aim is to create a suite of tests that thoroughly document and validate the behaviours throughout the Pod lifecycle. These tests will ensure that Pods function correctly during various phases, including creation, deletion, probe handling, restart policies, and termination scenarios.

Tasks:
- [ ] Create a new directory structure to organise tests by area and behaviour: test/e2e_node/AREA/BEHAVIOUR-SHORTNAME_test.go
 
**Write test cases for the following Pod lifecycle behaviours:**

Pod Phases:

- [ ]  Pending 
- [ ]  Running
- [ ]  Succeeded
- [ ]  Failed
- [ ]  Unknown

Container States:

- [ ]  Waiting
- [ ]  Running
- [ ] Terminated

Lifecycle Hooks:

- [ ] postStart Hook
- [ ] preStop Hook

Probes:

 - [ ] Liveness Probe
 - [ ] Readiness Probe 
 - [ ] Startup Probe

Restart Policies:

 - [ ] Always
 - [ ] OnFailure
 - [ ] Never

Pod Termination

 - [ ] Graceful Termination
 - [ ] Forced Termination

CrashLoopBackOff

- [ ] Test how Kubernetes handles retries when containers fail repeatedly and enter backoff.

Pod Conditions:

- [ ] PodScheduled: 
- [ ] Initialised
- [ ] ContainersReady:
- [ ] Ready

Fault Recovery:

- [ ] Initial Container Failure
- [ ] Repeated Failures

Node Failure and Pod Eviction:

- [ ] Test what happens when Pods are evicted due to node failure or resource shortages.
Pod Garbage Collection:
- [ ] Test the behaviour of the Kubernetes garbage collector when removing terminated Pods.

Sidecar Containers and Pod Shutdown:

 - [ ] Test how Kubernetes handles the termination order of sidecar containers during Pod shutdown.

**Expected Outcome:**
A set of well-organised and documented test files that demonstrate key Pod lifecycle behaviours, ensuring Pods function as expected throughout their lifecycle.
